## History

Carlo originally belonged to [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) for about a year before [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) married [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and subsequently left aboard the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters). After Leslie's mother died, Carlo stayed with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and became deeply attached to her, helping her endure her first year of grief through his devotion.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026)_

## Relationships

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carlo--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) is Carlo's owner, with Carlo serving as her beloved pet and long-time companion. Their relationship is defined by a deep, enduring bond of affection that has persisted through the fourth volume.
